evidence.evidence_note: Bolton's 2022 report identifies Bolton Group S.r.l. as the parent company directing and coordinating the Group and Bolton International division, and the same report lists Bolton BG Canada under 'Our Companies' in Canada. Bolton's official Rio Mare Canada contact page independently identifies the Canadian legal entity as Bolton BG Canada Inc., corporation 999667-2. Read together, these company-controlled sources support group-holding parentage; they do not identify the immediate legal shareholder or a direct ownership percentage.

The official Canadian Rio Mare contact page identifies Bolton BG Canada Inc. at 15 Gervais Drive, North York and gives commercial register number 999667-2. This supplies the exact legal-entity form for the shortened Bolton BG Canada name used in Bolton's group report.
Bolton's current legal page identifies the site controller as Bolton Group S.r.l., Milan, VAT 05983890152.

decision.basis: Bolton's 2022 report identifies Bolton Group S.r.l. as the Group parent and lists Bolton BG Canada among its companies; Bolton's official Canadian Rio Mare page identifies that Canadian company as Bolton BG Canada Inc., corporation 999667-2. This supports group-holding parentage only and does not assert the immediate legal shareholder.
